ReviewCard.status: OBSERVED: bundle 001 split; M4 build and focused tests pass
ReviewCard.capture_note: Screen Sharing crop from the M4 File Manager Demoboard showing the title, wrapping summary, verdict footer, selection fill, border, and focus treatment.
ReviewCard.summary: ReviewCard is a typed Card specialization that owns title, summary, and verdict Labels and atomically projects a bounded UTF-8 ReviewRecord into text, visual status, and semantics.

methods.ReviewCard: Constructs the three retained Label roles with theme-aware heading, body, and caption policies; attachment remains lazy and idempotent.
methods.initialize_control_tree: Attaches the three owned Labels to Card roles exactly once, allowing construction before shared ownership is established.
methods.title_label: Returns the owned header Label for ordinary Label-level customization.
methods.summary_label: Returns the owned wrapping body Label for ordinary Label-level customization.
methods.verdict_label: Returns the owned footer Label for ordinary Label-level customization.
methods.record_changed: Returns the event published after the complete record projection commits.
methods.measure: Ensures the internal tree exists, then uses Card's section measurement law.
methods.arrange: Ensures the internal tree exists, then uses Card's section arrangement law.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects title, summary, verdict, pending, and rejected state from the same committed record used by the visible Labels.

CorrespondenceView.status: OBSERVED: bundle 005 split and status-rail enhancement; M4 build, focused tests, and Screen Sharing pass
CorrespondenceView.capture_note: M4 File Manager Demoboard crop showing compact correspondence rows, an expanded matched excerpt, status rails, focus, and virtualization.
CorrespondenceView.summary: CorrespondenceView is a virtualized search/result correspondence surface whose stable rows can expand in response to explicit pinning or hover intent. It separates focus, selection, hover, and pin authority; preserves scroll anchors while variable row heights change; bounds realization; and exposes exact virtual semantics.

methods.CorrespondenceView: Constructs a focusable variable-height result surface with hover-intent scheduling and stable anchoring.
methods.items: Returns the authored correspondence records in ranking order.
methods.set_items: Validates stable identities, replaces the result model, and reconciles selection, focus, hover, pinning, and scroll anchoring.
methods.focused_id: Returns the keyboard-focused result independently of selection.
methods.hovered_id: Returns the result currently under hover intent, if any.
methods.expanded: Reports whether a result is expanded by pin or active hover intent.
methods.content_height: Returns total logical height of compact and expanded rows.
methods.realized_count: Returns the number of rows intersecting the current virtualization window.
methods.item_bounds: Returns a result's logical viewport-relative bounds when its identity exists.
methods.selection_changed: Returns the event published after authoritative result selection changes.
methods.pin_changed: Returns the event carrying the old and new explicitly pinned identities.
methods.expansion_changed: Returns the event describing rows entering or leaving expanded projection.
methods.item_activated: Returns the event carrying the qualified activated result.
methods.context_requested: Returns the event carrying result identity and position for owned context UI.
methods.arrange: Commits viewport size, clamps offset, and maintains the selected/focused result's reachability.
methods.on_paint: Records only realized compact or expanded rows, status rails, matched excerpts, hover, selection, and focus.
methods.on_pointer: Handles hover intent, selection, pin toggling, context requests, capture qualification, and activation.
methods.on_key: Implements variable-height navigation, paging, expansion/pinning, activation, and context request.
methods.on_focus_changed: Commits focus appearance and restores a usable focused result on entry.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects a result list with total and realized counts plus current selection.
methods.semantic_virtual_children: Exposes stable result nodes with correspondence descriptions, expanded/selected state, and actions.
methods.on_semantic_child_action: Routes virtual selection, expansion, collapse, and press through ordinary retained transitions.

RackModulePanel.status: OBSERVED: bundle 006 source-private responsive-control split; M4 build, focused tests, and Screen Sharing pass
RackModulePanel.capture_note: M4 File Manager Demoboard crop showing RackModulePanel instances arranging enable, fields, status, and remove roles across the rack.
RackModulePanel.summary: RackModulePanel is InstrumentRack's source-private retained module shell. It owns responsive horizontal/compact child arrangement and reorder semantics while InstrumentRack retains model, event, focus, scrolling, and reconciliation authority.

methods.RackModulePanel: Constructs a bordered module shell with reorder accessibility guidance.
methods.set_compact: Commits responsive stacked-field mode and invalidates child layout.
methods.compact: Reports whether fields are arranged vertically for a narrow slot.
methods.arrange: Arranges enable/remove edges, weighted horizontal fields or compact stacked fields, and status text.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects a named group with descendant inclusion and increment/decrement reorder actions.
methods.on_semantic_action: Maps decrement/increment to the rack-owned move callback.

InstrumentRack.status: OBSERVED: bundle 006 split with source-private module control; M4 build, focused tests, and Screen Sharing pass
InstrumentRack.capture_note: M4 File Manager Demoboard crop showing live and staged criteria modules, real choice controls, enable/remove actions, status text, and the Apply action subtree.
InstrumentRack.summary: InstrumentRack is a bounded retained editor rack that reconciles stable module/field identities across model replacements, owns real choice/text/check/button/status controls, preserves surviving focus and overlay state, responsively wraps or compacts modules, scrolls one plane, emits typed commit/toggle/remove/reorder events, and hosts an optional caller-owned action subtree.

methods.InstrumentRack: Constructs the rack coordinator, source-private module shells, and default layout policy.
methods.~InstrumentRack: Releases reconciled module state and owned subscriptions after normal Control disposal.
methods.modules: Returns the normalized caller-facing module model in current order.
methods.set_modules: Validates bounded UTF-8 identities/fields, reconciles surviving controls by stable ID, disposes removed shells, preserves useful focus, and refreshes layout.
methods.field_editor: Returns the real retained editor for a stable module/field pair.
methods.module_bounds: Returns the last logical rack bounds for a stable module.
methods.set_module_enabled: Commits module enabled state and synchronizes descendants and public model.
methods.set_module_state: Commits live/staged/pending/invalid state and status text, then refreshes presentation.
methods.set_field_value: Synchronizes one real editor and public model without emitting a user commit.
methods.set_field_validation: Commits validation text and refreshes module/accessibility presentation.
methods.set_action_content: Validates and assumes ownership of an unparented action subtree plus its minimum slot width.
methods.action_content: Returns the optional caller-owned retained action subtree.
methods.content_height: Returns the last computed wrapped content height.
methods.preferred_height: Computes bounded wrapped height for a positive available width without arranging.
methods.field_changed: Returns the event for live text/choice transitions.
methods.field_committed: Returns the event for qualified field commits.
methods.module_toggled: Returns the event for committed enable-state changes.
methods.remove_requested: Returns the event requesting consumer-authorized module removal.
methods.move_requested: Returns the event requesting a stable module reorder.
methods.measure: Computes desired height from the responsive slot algorithm and available viewport.
methods.arrange: Commits bounds and arranges reconciled module/action slots against current scroll origin.
methods.on_pointer: Consumes wheel input to scroll the rack through its clamped state machine.
methods.on_pointer_bubble: Accepts unhandled descendant wheel input into the same rack scroll path.
methods.on_key_preview: Maps Alt+Left/Right from a focused module descendant to typed reorder requests.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects a named group, module count, and included real descendants.

CorrespondenceItem.summary: CorrespondenceItem owns stable identity, primary/secondary text, status, hierarchy, pinned/expanded policy, and optional command data for one correspondence row.

CorrespondenceSelectionChange.summary: CorrespondenceSelectionChange reports old/new optional stable identities and the initiating interaction.

CorrespondencePinChange.summary: CorrespondencePinChange reports the exact row and resulting pinned state.

CorrespondenceExpansionChange.summary: CorrespondenceExpansionChange reports the exact hierarchical row and resulting expanded state.

ReviewRecord.summary: ReviewRecord owns the stable author, timestamp, score/status, title, body, and metadata projected by ReviewCard.

ScrollAnchor.summary: ScrollAnchor preserves a stable row identity plus intra-row offset so refreshes restore semantic rather than index-only position.
